enchantments.tooltip: Search +7: Passive: +7 Competence bonus to the Search skill.
Spot +7: Passive: +7 Competence bonus to the Spot skill.

Absorb Beholder Spells: This effect absorbs most spells cast by beholder eyestalks. Only a few such spells can be absorbed before the item ceases to function and must have time to dissipate the absorbed energy.
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
